title: OpenVA Public Vendor Assurance Source References
subtitle: Public-source-only metadata for vendor-published assurance reference URLs
description: OpenVA is a public-source-only metadata dataset for vendor-published assurance references such as trust centers, privacy pages, security pages, data processing addenda, subprocessor lists, status pages, public certification references, public KYC/AML statements, AI/data terms, and related source references. It records factual locator metadata only. It does not certify, approve, score, monitor, assess, or advise on vendors and does not replace legal, compliance, procurement, security, audit, KYC, AML, sanctions, regulatory, or vendor-risk review. Source of truth: https://github.com/thedanieltan/open-vendor-assurance. Browser app: https://thedanieltan.github.io/open-vendor-assurance/.
